text: The Claude adapter v0.101.0 keeps a subagent's history in its own transcript file and replays it on `session/load` only to clients that speak its subagent-sessions protocol (the RFD or AIR forms), not to clients that declare only the `subagent-transcript` meta. coax declares only that meta, so a resumed session shows each subagent as a folded `agent` block with no children (46805c3). Source: `replaySessionHistory` in the adapter's `src/acp-agent.ts`.
